title: How to Secure Your Vacation Home Rental Property
summary: Own an Airbnb or Vrbo property? Here's how to keep your short- and long-term vacation rentals protected while you're away.
body_markdown:
With the rental platform policy in mind, it’s time to start thinking about what vacation home security cameras you need and where you should place them.


The doorbell is a great place to start. It protects the main point of entry for the property and provides an excellent opportunity to monitor who’s coming and going — especially when your property isn’t currently being rented. Consider options that offer a wide field of view and allow you to communicate directly with visitors through an intercom speaker system.


As for covering the rest of the exterior, take a look at the areas around your property, look for potential blind spots, and choose cameras that can best cover those spaces.


For example, a floodlight camera can be a great fit for the front lawn, automatically shining a light on the area whenever it detects motion; a great way to keep visitors safe as they return to the rental property at night while discouraging thieves from approaching. Meanwhile, general purpose outdoor cameras make a great fit for side areas, the backyard, and around pool and patio areas.


The best combination of outdoor security cameras will provide both you and your guests with peace of mind without being overly invasive. Smart, thoughtful choices and installation will help you achieve that goal.
